title: Sudden Impact
caption: Sudden Impact (V)
game_text: Deploy on table with 5 cards from outside your deck face-down under here. Three times per game, may play a Defensive Shield from here (as if from hand). {lightsaber} weapons may not reset forfeit to 0. Characters hit by {lightsaber} weapons are forfeit = (printed forfeit -3).
lore: An asteroid looming in one’s path can force a quick decision. One must choose, but choose wisely. This pilot chose poorly.
